heroHeading: Healing from Within, Guided by Nature
heroLead: Your journey to wellness, rooted in nature. Individualized online homoeopathic consultations with Dr. Pujaa Scinde (BHMS), tailored to your symptoms, health history, and personal needs.
aboutPreviewText1: Dr. Pujaa believes homeopathy works best as a continuous, honest partnership between doctor and patient. Every case begins with a detailed history — your symptoms, lifestyle, and emotional wellbeing — before arriving at an individualized remedy.
aboutPreviewText2: She works with patients across acute complaints, chronic conditions, and everyday family health, through online consultations.
aboutPreviewQuote: Every consultation begins with truly listening — to your symptoms, your story, and what makes you, you.
